artifacts.name: ai_forward_speed_estimator_v2
artifacts.role: Model A — Speed Estimator (Real-Data Heading Invariant)
artifacts.training_data: 12 candidate IO-VNBD drives under documented reconciliation exception; note that formal reports/training_admission.json still records 0 approved sequences due to export-frame decoupling.
limitations: Data diversity: 12 drives from mostly one driver and one vehicle type (VW Golf/Passat); does not generalize across diverse vehicle classes.
Mixed-frame export: body-fixed horizontal acceleration magnitude used due to smartphone-to-vehicle frame misalignment.
Non-admitted data: trained under research exception; not field-validated or admitted under formal gate criteria.
Offline replay only: evaluated via retrospective offline sliding windows; edge streaming latencies and online causal filtering not verified in-vehicle.

policy: Model A runs causal inference on 1-second IMU sliding windows (100 Hz). v1 uses 6 vehicle-frame channels (synthetic); v2 uses 4 heading-invariant channels (real-data LOGO).
